changed.new: member is the estimator and its pattern_stratified arm is the published one; event is the naive independent-years alternative the production numbers implicitly assume; year is the crossed shared-forcing axis, which needs no stratification because every warming year block carries the six patterns in equal numbers; sst is the six warming sea-surface patterns and is structural climate-model spread rather than hazard-sampling noise, reported because it is the largest measured grouping and never quoted as the sampling interval.
